shlokas.text: ॐ पूर्णमदः पूर्णमिदं पूर्णात् पूर्णमुदच्यते । पूर्णस्य पूर्णमादाय पूर्णमेवावशिष्यते ॥ ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः ॥ ॥ अथ ईशोपनिषत् ॥ ॐ ईशा वास्यमिदꣳ सर्वं यत्किञ्च जगत्यां जगत् । तेन त्यक्तेन भुञ्जीथा मा गृधः कस्यस्विद्धनम्
shlokas.english_draft: Om! That is infinite, this is infinite; from the infinite arises the infinite. Taking the infinite from the infinite, the infinite alone remains. Om peace, peace, peace! Om! All this—whatever moves in this moving world—is enfolded by the Lord. Enjoy by renouncing it; do not covet anyone's wealth.

shlokas.text: कुर्वन्नेवेह कर्माणि जिजीविषेच्छतꣳ समाः । एवं त्वयि नान्यथेतोऽस्ति न कर्म लिप्यते नरे
shlokas.english_draft: Performing duties here indeed, one should wish to live a hundred years. Thus for you, there is no other way than this; karma does not cling to man.

shlokas.text: असुर्या नाम ते लोका अन्धेन तमसाऽऽवृताः । ताꣳस्ते प्रेत्याभिगच्छन्ति ये के चात्महनो जनाः
shlokas.english_draft: Demoniac indeed are those worlds, enveloped in blinding darkness. To them after death go those who slay the Self.

shlokas.text: अनेजदेकं मनसो जवीयो नैनद्देवा आप्नुवन्पूर्वमर्षत् । तद्धावतोऽन्यानत्येति तिष्ठत्तस्मिन्नपो मातरिश्वा दधाति
shlokas.english_draft: Unmoving, one, faster than the mind; the senses could not overtake It, for It raced ahead. Standing still, It overtakes others who run. In It, Matarishvan (vital force) establishes all activity.

shlokas.text: तदेजति तन्नैजति तद्दूरे तद्वन्तिके । तदन्तरस्य सर्वस्य तदु सर्वस्यास्य बाह्यतः
shlokas.english_draft: It moves and It moves not; It is far and It is near. It is within all this, and It is outside all this.

shlokas.text: यस्तु सर्वाणि भूतान्यात्मन्येवानुपश्यति । सर्वभूतेषु चात्मानं ततो न विजुगुप्सते
shlokas.english_draft: He who sees all beings in the Self alone, and the Self in all beings, feels no aversion thereafter.

shlokas.text: यस्मिन्सर्वाणि भूतान्यात्मैवाभूद्विजानतः । तत्र को मोहः कः शोक एकत्वमनुपश्यतः
shlokas.english_draft: When to the knower all beings have become the Self alone, what delusion, what sorrow can there be for him who beholds oneness?

shlokas.text: स पर्यगाच्छुक्रमकायमव्रण- मस्नाविरꣳ शुद्धमपापविद्धम् । कविर्मनीषी परिभूः स्वयम्भू- र्याथातथ्यतोऽर्थान् व्यदधाच्छाश्वतीभ्यः समाभ्यः
shlokas.english_draft: He pervaded all—radiant, bodiless, scarless, sinewless, pure, untouched by evil. Seer, thinker, all-encompassing, self-existent, He has assigned objects properly to eternal years.

shlokas.text: अन्धं तमः प्रविशन्ति येऽविद्यामुपासते । ततो भूय इव ते तमो य उ विद्यायाꣳ रताः
shlokas.english_draft: Into blinding darkness enter those who worship ignorance; into greater darkness enter those who are devoted to knowledge alone.

shlokas.text: अन्यदेवाहुर्विद्ययाऽन्यदाहुरविद्यया । इति शुश्रुम धीराणां ये नस्तद्विचचक्षिरे
shlokas.english_draft: One result, they say, is obtained by Vidya, and another by Avidya. Thus have we heard from the wise who explained it to us.

shlokas.text: विद्यां चाविद्यां च यस्तद्वेदोभयꣳ सह । अविद्यया मृत्युं तीर्त्वा विद्ययाऽमृतमश्नुते
shlokas.english_draft: He who knows both Vidya and Avidya together overcomes death through Avidya and attains immortality through Vidya.

shlokas.text: अन्धं तमः प्रविशन्ति येऽसम्भूतिमुपासते । ततो भूय इव ते तमो य उ सम्भूत्याꣳ रताः
shlokas.english_draft: Into blinding darkness enter those who worship unmanifest nature; into greater darkness enter those who are devoted to manifest creation.

shlokas.text: अन्यदेवाहुः सम्भवादन्यदाहुरसम्भवात् । इति शुश्रुम धीराणां ये नस्तद्विचचक्षिरे
shlokas.english_draft: One result, they say, is obtained from Sambhuti, and another from Asambhuti. Thus have we heard from the wise who explained it to us.

shlokas.text: सम्भूतिं च विनाशं च यस्तद्वेदोभयꣳ सह । विनाशेन मृत्युं तीर्त्वा सम्भूत्याऽमृतमश्नुते
shlokas.english_draft: He who knows both Sambhuti and Destruction together overcomes death through Destruction and attains immortality through Sambhuti.

shlokas.text: हिरण्मयेन पात्रेण सत्यस्यापिहितं मुखम् । तत्त्वं पूषन्नपावृणु सत्यधर्माय दृष्टये
shlokas.english_draft: The face of Truth is covered by a golden vessel. Unveil it, O Sun (Pushan), so that I who am devoted to Truth may behold It!

shlokas.text: पूषन्नेकर्षे यम सूर्य प्राजापत्य व्यूह रश्मीन् समूह तेजः । यत्ते रूपं कल्याणतमं तत्ते पश्यामि योऽसावसौ पुरुषः सोऽहमस्मि
shlokas.english_draft: O Pushan, sole Seer, Controller, Sun, offspring of Prajapati! Gather your rays, withdraw your intense light. That form of yours which is most auspicious, that I behold. He who is that Purusha, I am He!

shlokas.text: वायुरनिलममृतमथेदं भस्मान्तꣳ शरीरम् । ॐ क्रतो स्मर कृतꣳ स्मर क्रतो स्मर कृतꣳ स्मर
shlokas.english_draft: Let breath join the immortal air! Then let this body end in ashes. Om! O Mind, remember! Remember what was done! O Mind, remember! Remember what was done!

shlokas.text: अग्ने नय सुपथा राये अस्मान् विश्वानि देव वयुनानि विद्वान् । युयोध्यस्मज्जुहुराणमेनो भूयिष्ठां ते नमौक्तिं विधेम
shlokas.english_draft: O Agni! Lead us by the good path to prosperity, O God who knowest all our deeds! Remove from us deceitful sin. To Thee we offer our abundant salutations.
